text:
kai_wu: Heads-up: BankCorp procurement wants an air-gapped POC delivered via encrypted SSD (sneakernet). Must support incremental patches (no full image every time), manifest + verifiable COSE signatures, and a documented upgrade cadence to include in their SOW. Also asked for per-site offline premium pricing.

lena_roberts: We can support encrypted-SSD delivery. We have chunked deltas + manifest verification. Notes: delta efficiency depends on model shard layout; some quantized shards may require full replacement. Agent minimum for delta apply = 2.5.0.

oscar_mendez: Ops notes / demo command:
```sh
# apply from mounted SSD
redwood-offline-apply --manifest /mnt/ssd/manifest.json --verify --cose
```
We support signing with our key or customer's COSE-compatible key. HSM-backed signing (PKCS#11) is available for enterprise. We also include sha256 checksums next to bundles.

eng-sales-bot: POC ticket created: POC-11011 assigned to oscar_mendez. https://app.redwood/POC-11011

security_tess: Security checklist to return pre-SOW: SBOM acceptance format, root CA/COSE key exchange method, whether customer requires local HSM signing, telemetry retention opt-out, and any additional audit artifacts. I can send a one-page questionnaire.

kai_wu: Pricing suggestion for sales: baseline offline plan = $17k/yr/site (includes encrypted packaging, 1 quarterly delta, manifest signing). Monthly cadence SLA = +$7k/yr/site. Ad-hoc hotfix (48h) = $5k/event. Onsite support / travel = T&M.

lena_roberts: Cadence recommendation: default quarterly for offline; monthly as paid upgrade. We require scheduled maintenance windows and explicit customer acceptance before applying.

oscar_mendez: I'll prepare a small signed COSE demo delta and a README for the SSD drop. Example manifest (demo):
```
{
  "manifest_version": "1.1",
  "site": "bankcorp-prod-poc",
  "bundles": ["runtime-4.0.zst","models/secured-gptq"],
  "delta": true,
  "sig_format": "COSE",
  "sig": "eyJhbGciOiJF..."
}
```
security_tess: If they can provide their COSE public key ahead of the call we can demo end-to-end verification. I'll attach the questionnaire and a short CA/key exchange doc before EOD.

kai_wu: Plan: kickoff call Thurs 2pm PT. Agenda: show `redwood-offline-apply` from SSD, demo COSE signature verify, discuss cadence & pricing, and go over security checklist. Can everyone make it? :calendar:

lena_roberts: I can.

oscar_mendez: Same. I'll upload signed demo bundle by Wed.

security_tess: I'll join and bring the questionnaire.

kai_wu: Great — thanks team.
